title: Integrations
description: Integrations bring your devices into ControlHome: a vendor's cloud, a hub, or a protocol on your network.

empty.title: Connect your first devices
empty.description: Pick what your devices use — a vendor's app, a hub, or a protocol such as MQTT — and follow the guided setup. Just looking around? The simulated home brings a whole house of devices to try every control.

delete.title: Remove {name}?
delete.description: It has no devices. | Its device goes with it, including its history. | Its {count} devices go with it, including their history.

catalog.title: Add an integration
catalog.description: Choose what your devices connect through. Each one walks you through its setup.

about.simulated: A simulated home that behaves like the real thing: lights, plugs, climate, locks, a washer, cameras and more.
about.mqtt: Your MQTT broker: Zigbee2MQTT, Home Assistant discovery and Tasmota devices.

setup.title: Set up an integration
setup.reauthDone: {name} is signed in again. Its devices stay as they were.

flow.external: This step happens on {host}. Open it, finish there, then come back.
flow.unsafeUrl: The page this step points to isn't a secure (https) address, so it isn't shown.
flow.retrying: Lost touch with the server for a moment; trying again…

review.title: No devices found | 1 device found | {count} devices found
review.description: Keep the ones you want to see, and put each in its room. Rooms are suggested from the device names; you can change everything later.
review.waiting: The devices arrive a moment after the integration starts.
review.none: No devices showed up yet. They can take a while; they'll appear in your device list as they come in.
review.noRooms: Draw your floors and rooms to put devices in them.
review.stillArriving: More devices may still be arriving…
review.saved: All set: no devices kept. | All set: 1 device is ready. | All set: {count} devices are ready.

detail.title: Integration
detail.needsReauthTitle: This integration needs you to sign in again
detail.needsReauth: Its devices are kept; they come back once it is signed in.
detail.orphaned: No devices are orphaned | 1 device is no longer reported by this integration. | {n} devices are no longer reported by this integration.
detail.noDevices: No devices yet. They appear here as the integration finds them.
detail.noDevicesOff: No devices. Turn the integration on to find them.
detail.enabledHelp: Turned off, it stops talking to its devices; they stay, with their history.
